name: myb-roster-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for MYB Roster App

comments.overrides: uuid pinned to >=11.1.1 to clear GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (moderate) — a missing buffer bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when a `buf` arg is provided. It reaches us only transitively via @google-cloud/storage -> gaxios/teeny-request, which call uuid.v4() (no buf), so the flaw is not actually reachable; the override removes the advisory noise without a breaking firebase-admin major. Revisit/remove when @google-cloud/storage ships uuid>=11.1.1 upstream.
